mike.h: logs show increased tail latency on the embedding encoder model process. Looks like long GC pauses on a few nodes. posting a sample: ```
[2026-03-15T02:14:03Z] encoder-3 - pause for 1.7s - heap growth
[2026-03-15T02:14:07Z] encoder-5 - pause for 2.1s - full GC
```

lisa: those GC pauses coincide with a scheduled nightly heap compaction from the JVM tuning PR we rolled yesterday. I think we triggered an aggressive compaction mode for instances with memory >70%.

mike.h: can we disable compaction safely?

raj: yes — patching the JVM flag in the config map now. applying: ```kubectl patch configmap embeddings-jvm --patch '{"data":{"JVM_FLAGS":"-XX:-UseG1GCCompaction"}}' -n prod-euw```

ops-bot: deploy triggered: configmap updated -> rolling restart of encoder pods. 6/8 pods restarted.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-20260315-emb-latency ; priority: P1 ; owner: mike.h ; start_ts: 1768425600

mike.h: rolling restart working, latencies trending down. still seeing a couple >2s. continuing monitoring.

sara: I'm going to flip alert to page only on sustained firing to reduce noise while we assess. Proposal: change alert rule from "count_over_5m(fire) > 5" -> "count_over_10m(fire) > 10" temporarily.

kevin: agree, current sensitivity is spamming nights. Make sure we annotate the change in the alert history.

mike.h: do it and link to the incident. Use short TTL (2h) so we revert if things look unstable.

raj: updated rule in alertmanager: ```yaml
- alert: EmbeddingsP99High
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, service)) > 2
  for: 10m  # changed from 5m temporarily
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency
    incident: INC-20260315-emb-latency
```
